شَاعٌ , originally شَائِعٌ: see the latter word. ―
-b2- Also The urine of the she-camel, that becomes scattered when the stallion leaps her. (As, O, K.) And, (As, O, [accord. to the K “ or, ”] The urine of the he-camel when he is excited by lust. (As, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
